name: synergy-engine
description: Unity-style game engine template for TypeScript, built on PlayCanvas. Clone it, build your game.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p convex/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p cloudflare/tsconfig.json
scripts.desktop:dev: bun run scripts/build.ts --outdir desktop/dist && cd desktop && bun ../node_modules/electrobun/bin/electrobun.cjs dev
scripts.desktop:build: bun run scripts/build.ts --outdir desktop/dist && cd desktop && bun ../node_modules/electrobun/bin/electrobun.cjs build --env=stable
